## 🌡️ MARKET ATMOSPHERE

**1. Global Risk Regime?**
NEUTRAL: Breadth: 5/11 sectors positive. SPY ABOVE TREND (1W: +0.54% | 1M: +8.70%) and XLK ABOVE TREND (1W: +3.80% | 1M: +17.15%) show equity momentum while Credit stress rising via HYG (1W: -0.21% | 1M: +1.83%) / LQD (1W: -0.40% | 1M: +1.21%) and VXX RECOVERY (1W: +2.80% | 1M: -13.02%) create offsetting caution.

**2. Primary Risk Drivers?**
SPY/TLT ↑ (1W: +1.13% | 1M: +9.47%) ABOVE TREND signaling stocks over bonds; Credit Spread (level 0.7343) 1W: +0.27% | 1M: +0.45% ABOVE TREND signals rising stress; VXX RECOVERY (1W: +2.80% | 1M: -13.02%) ↑ rising shows a near-term uptick in fear.

**3. Financial Conditions Signal?**
Dollar neutral/recovering (Dollar 1W: +0.59% | 1M: -1.19%) RECOVERY; Yield dynamics mixed with TLT CORRECTION (1W: -0.41% | 1M: +0.25%) and Yield Curve → flat (1W: -0.35% | 1M: +0.37%) CORRECTION.

## 📈 EQUITIES & FLOWS

**4. Sector Leadership?**
Technology leading: XLK ABOVE TREND (1W: +3.80% | 1M: +17.15%) and SOXX ABOVE TREND (1W: +11.04% | 1M: +33.70%); Financials lag with XLF in CORRECTION (1W: -2.23% | 1M: +5.83%). Style: Growth/Momentum showing strength versus Value.

**5. US vs Global?**
US outperforms: SPY ABOVE TREND (1W: +0.54% | 1M: +8.70%); EM mixed with EEM ABOVE TREND (1W: +0.16% | 1M: +11.01%) while China FXI CORRECTION (1W: -1.97% | 1M: +2.39%) and broad Europe/Asia metrics are weaker.

**6. Speculative Appetite?**
Speculative flows mixed: IBIT ABOVE TREND (1W: +0.18% | 1M: +9.58%) and IWM ABOVE TREND (1W: +0.32% | 1M: +9.86%) show risk-seeking, while ARKK CORRECTION (1W: -3.45% | 1M: +9.44%) signals selective profit-taking.

## 🛢️ REAL ECONOMY

**7. Commodities Theme?**
Oil strength evident: USO ABOVE TREND (1W: +14.10% | 1M: +16.77%) and BNO ABOVE TREND (1W: +15.66% | 1M: +7.83%); Copper CPER CORRECTION (1W: -0.94% | 1M: +9.32%) and Gold GLD CORRECTION (1W: -2.84% | 1M: +4.07%) showing short-term pullbacks.

**8. Energy Trend?**
Energy mixed-to-strong: XLE RECOVERY (1W: +3.36% | 1M: -6.11%) ABOVE short-term momentum while Natural Gas UNG BELOW TREND (1W: -4.89% | 1M: -13.07%) remains weak.

## 🧭 STRATEGY

**9. Trend Confirmation?**
CONFIRMED: Tech leadership (XLK, QQQ, SOXX both timeframes positive) supports risk tilt; DIVERGENCE: Credit stress (HYG/LQD) and TLT mismatch vs equities (minor divergence across XLF and TLT) — not yet a regime flip.

**10. Portfolio Direction?**
Favor exposure to Growth/Tech (XLK (1W: +3.80% | 1M: +17.15%) ABOVE TREND; SOXX (1W: +11.04% | 1M: +33.70%) ABOVE TREND) and monitor credit-sensitive positions; reduce exposure to interest-rate sensitive / defensive pockets until credit signals stabilize.

## 🔮 NEXT WEEK OUTLOOK

**11. Sectors to Watch?**
BULLISH: XLK ABOVE TREND (1W: +3.80% | 1M: +17.15%) — watch continuation; SOXX ABOVE TREND (1W: +11.04% | 1M: +33.70%) — watch momentum.  
BEARISH: XLF CORRECTION (1W: -2.23% | 1M: +5.83%) — monitor further downside; XBI CORRECTION (1W: -3.89% | 1M: +7.55%) — biotech softness.

**12. Commodities to Watch?**
BULLISH: USO ABOVE TREND (1W: +14.10% | 1M: +16.77%) and BNO ABOVE TREND (1W: +15.66% | 1M: +7.83%) — oil strength.  
BEARISH: UNG BELOW TREND (1W: -4.89% | 1M: -13.07%) — gas weakness; GLD CORRECTION (1W: -2.84% | 1M: +4.07%) — watch for further gold pullback.

**13. Key Levels?**
VXX ~20 (complacency threshold), Credit Spread ~0.73 (widening risk), XLK/XLF ratio ~3.12 (tech vs financials pivot), SPY/TLT momentum (1W: +1.13% | 1M: +9.47%) ABOVE TREND.

## 📝 EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

NEUTRAL: Breadth: 5/11 sectors positive, mixed equity momentum vs rising credit stress. Tech/Growth showing relative strength (XLK, SOXX ABOVE TREND). Key risk is rising credit stress and a VXX uptick—monitor HYG/LQD and XLF/TLT divergences.
